definitions.explanation: a reference work containing articles on various subjects or specialized fields

examples.japanese: {百科|ひゃっか}{事典|じてん}で{調|しら}べた。
examples.english: I looked it up in an encyclopedia.

examples.japanese: ウィキペディアはオンライン{百科|ひゃっか}{事典|じてん}だ。
{子供|こども}{向|む}けの{百科|ひゃっか}{事典|じてん}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought an encyclopedia for children.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
- {百科|ひゃっか}{事典|じてん} - encyclopedia (the full term)
- {百科|ひゃっか}{全書|ぜんしょ} - comprehensive encyclopedia

ETYMOLOGY:
{百|ひゃく} (hundred) + {科|か} (branch/subject) = literally "hundred subjects," meaning comprehensive knowledge.

FAMOUS ENCYCLOPEDIAS:
- {世界大百科事典|せかいだいひゃっかじてん} (World Encyclopedia)
- ブリタニカ{百科|ひゃっか}{事典|じてん} (Encyclopædia Britannica)
